Delta_One_Momentum_Plan_Presentation.text: Let's start with the presentation. It is seventeen slides, and I read them to you in the video. Here is the big idea. You buy a module. The module can give back up to two times its price, and the price is part of that. When you introduce people, you get two percent of what their contracts earn each day. That can reach twenty-one levels deep. Watch it once, slowly. Then watch it again with a friend. Remember: every number is an average, not a promise.
Delta_One_Momentum_Plan_Presentation.title: Momentum Plan Presentation

Delta_One_7_Summits_to_Success.text: This is the whole plan on one page. Think of it as a map of seven mountains. Each mountain is a rank. Fuji is the first. Everest is the last. Each rank lets you get paid on three more levels. Fuji pays three levels. Everest pays twenty-one. Under each mountain you see what the rank needs, and the daily cap. The cap is the most the base matrix can pay you in one day. Ask yourself: which mountain am I climbing right now? Pin this page up. Every number is an illustration at the average.
Delta_One_7_Summits_to_Success.title: 7 Summits to Success

Delta_One_Momentum_Plan_Guide.text: This is the rule book. When someone asks, what is the exact rule, the answer is in here. It has the rank table: what you buy, how many people you enroll, and how much volume your team needs. It has worked examples, with real-looking numbers, for a small module and a big one. You do not need to read it all today. Keep it close, and look things up. And remember the sentence that goes with every number: results are not guaranteed, and most members earn no commission at all.
Delta_One_Momentum_Plan_Guide.title: Momentum Plan Guide

Delta_One_Line_Balance_Rule.text: This is one rule on one page, and it matters a lot. Your rank is built on your team's volume. But no single line can carry you. At Fuji, one line can count for half of your volume, no more. Higher up, it gets stricter: a third, then a quarter, then a fifth. So what do you do? You build wide. More lines, not one tall tower. When someone asks why their rank did not move, the answer is usually here.
Delta_One_Line_Balance_Rule.title: Line Balance Rule

Delta_One_Momentum_Plan_Breakage_Differe.text: This is how leaders get paid. Here is the simple picture. Every rank has a number, from six percent at Fuji to forty-two percent at Everest. A leader gets the gap between their number and the biggest number already used below them, on the same contract. So if you stay ahead of your people, the gap is yours. If they catch up, the gap gets smaller. The total on any contract never goes past forty-two percent. Two lessons: stay ahead, and open new lines.
Delta_One_Momentum_Plan_Breakage_Differe.title: Breakage Differential

Delta_One_Momentum_Plan_Distributor_Guid.text: This is the plan written for you, the distributor. Every rule comes with the reason behind it. You will find the words we use, the rank table, the daily caps, and how leaders are paid. Best of all, it has four worked stories, from a small team to a big one, with the numbers shown step by step. Read it on your second day. Then read it again in a month; you will see more the second time. Every story is an illustration at the average. Most members earn no commission at all.
Delta_One_Momentum_Plan_Distributor_Guid.title: Distributor Guide

Delta_One_Momentum_Plan_Cheat_Sheet.text: This is the plan on a single page, for when you need a number fast. At the top, the rank table. In the middle, the three ways a contract pays: by level, by the differential, and the daily cap. At the bottom, five rules to remember. Keep it next to you when you talk to people. If you can explain this one page, you can explain the plan. The numbers are illustrations, not promises.
Delta_One_Momentum_Plan_Cheat_Sheet.title: Cheat Sheet

Delta_One_Momentum_Plan_Napkin.text: This is the napkin. It is the plan in four little drawings, the way you would draw it over coffee. Drawing one: a member buys a module. Drawing two: of every one hundred USDT the engine makes, fifty go to members, twenty-five to the plan, and twenty-five to the company. Drawing three: balanced lines. Drawing four: paid two ways. Try it yourself. Take a napkin and draw the four pictures. If you can draw it, you understand it.
Delta_One_Momentum_Plan_Napkin.title: Napkin Presentation

Delta_One_Momentum_Plan_Simple_Words.text: This is The Plan in Simple Words. One idea on each page. One picture. Three or four short sentences. It starts with what you buy. Then the daily share. Then the switch on day eleven. Then friends and levels. Then the seven mountains. The last page is the warning page, and it is the most important page. Give this to anyone who finds the other documents hard. It also comes in nineteen languages.
Delta_One_Momentum_Plan_Simple_Words.title: The Plan in Simple Words

Delta_One_Module_Product_Guide.text: This is the product guide. It tells the story of a module from the first day to the last. First, how one day works: the engine makes a result, and at twelve noon UTC it is shared out. Then the first eleven days, when every result buys a new little module. Then day eleven, when you get a switch: keep rebuying, or send results to your wallet. Then the end, when the module has given back two times its price. Read it after the Key Facts, before you buy.
Delta_One_Module_Product_Guide.title: Module Product Guide

Delta_One_Module_Key_Facts.text: This is the most important page of all. Read it before you buy anything. Everyone does. It says what a module is: a software purchase. Not a deposit. Not an investment. You cannot get the price back. It says what can go wrong: some days the result is zero, and nothing is guaranteed. And it says the golden rule: only use money you can afford to lose. If you remember one page, remember this one.
Delta_One_Module_Key_Facts.title: Key Facts & Risks

Delta_One_Module_FAQ.text: These are the questions members ask, with short honest answers. What happens on a day with no profit? Nothing is paid. What do the first eleven days do? Every result rebuys. What is the most a module can give? Two times its price, price included. Where does my money go? To the app wallet, when the switch is off. When a question comes up twice, look here. Then you will have the answer ready the third time.
Delta_One_Module_FAQ.title: Member FAQ

Delta_One_Believer_Illustration.text: This is the story of the Believer. A Believer keeps Auto-Rebuy on for the whole life of a module. In return, the module can give back two hundred and twenty percent instead of two hundred. The document shows one ten thousand USDT module, at the average, growing into a whole fleet of little modules by day four hundred and forty. It is a story with numbers, not a promise. Real days vary. The choice is binding, so read it slowly before day eleven.
Delta_One_Believer_Illustration.title: The Believer

Delta_One_Founder_Profile_James_Pack.text: This is the profile of James Pack, the founder of Delta One. Three things to know: forty years of building businesses; he co-founded ASEA; and his own words about what Delta One stands for. The last page is a card you can share. It is marked a draft until the founders sign it off.
Delta_One_Founder_Profile_James_Pack.title: James Pack

Delta_One_Founder_Profile_Ricky_Lundell.text: This is the profile of Ricky Lundell, the president of Delta One. Three things to know: he is a world champion, more than once; he coached UFC world champions; and he holds a team to a high standard. The last page is a card you can share. It is marked a draft until the founders sign it off.
Delta_One_Founder_Profile_Ricky_Lundell.title: Ricky Lundell

Delta_One_Founders_The_Partnership.text: This is the story of the two founders working together. What each one brings. How the company is run, with more than one key needed to move money. And why that matters to you. When someone asks, who are these people, this is the page to open.
Delta_One_Founders_The_Partnership.title: The Partnership

Delta_One_Which_Document_Do_I_Need.text: This is your map of all the documents. Each one gets one line: what it is, who it is for, and when to open it. The first table is the best part. Find what you want to do on the left. The document to open is on the right. If you only ever read three documents, read the Key Facts, The Plan in Simple Words, and the Language Card. Open this map whenever you feel lost.
Delta_One_Which_Document_Do_I_Need.title: Which document do I need?

Delta_One_Distributor_Kit_Index.text: This is the index of your kit. Your kit is eighteen short documents, in the order you need them. Step zero comes before anything: the Key Facts and the disclosure. Then step one, step two, all the way to step nine. It also tells you who gets which document, and what you never hand to a prospect. And it gives you a five-day plan for your first week. Start here on day one.
Delta_One_Distributor_Kit_Index.title: The Distributor Kit Index

Delta_One_Rewards_Disclosure_Statement.text: This page tells the truth about rewards, rank by rank. The most important line is this one: most members earn no commission at all. The numbers are model numbers at the average, not a record of what people made. Real rewards need a real team, and most people never build one. Give this page to every prospect, with the Key Facts. Every time.
Delta_One_Rewards_Disclosure_Statement.title: Rewards Disclosure Statement

Delta_One_Language_Card.text: This is the Language Card: the words we say and the words we never say. We say purchase, never investment. We say result, never return. We say rebuy, never reinvest. We say rewards, never income. It also gives you five sentences you can always say, safely. Read it before your first conversation. Then read it again once a week. Words matter.
Delta_One_Language_Card.title: The Language Card

Delta_One_Rank_Roadmap.text: This is the Rank Roadmap: one page for each of the seven mountains. For each rank: what it needs, what a team that holds it looks like, and what the smallest team at that rank pays, at the average. Use it to pick your next goal. One mountain at a time. The numbers are illustrations, not promises.
Delta_One_Rank_Roadmap.title: The Rank Roadmap

Delta_One_Getting_Started_Checklist.text: This is your checklist for day one. Do it with your sponsor, and tick every box. First the account and the identity check. Then the wallet. Then your own module. Then the first eleven days, and the decision on day eleven. Then your tools, and your first conversations. Go in order. Do not skip a box.
Delta_One_Getting_Started_Checklist.title: Getting Started Checklist

Delta_One_USDT_and_Wallet_Guide.text: This guide is for anyone who has never used USDT. Take it slowly. USDT is a digital dollar. Delta One uses it on one network, called B E P twenty. The network must be right, every time. It shows you how to buy USDT, how to send it to the app, and how to take money out, with a five USDT minimum. And it lists the mistakes that lose money, so you can avoid them. Read it before your first purchase.
Delta_One_USDT_and_Wallet_Guide.title: USDT & Wallet Guide

Delta_One_First_90_Days_Workbook.text: This is your first ninety days on paper. Use a pen. Page by page: your first three days, your first week, your first month, and day ninety. Write your goals. Write the lines you will open. Write your list of fifty people. On day eleven, day thirty and day ninety, come back and check. The live planner on this site does the same thing on your phone.
Delta_One_First_90_Days_Workbook.title: First 90 Days Workbook

Delta_One_Member_Journey_Calendar.text: This is a calendar of a member's module. Day zero, the purchase. Day one, the first result. Day eleven, the switch. Day two hundred and day four hundred, the big milestones. Day four hundred and forty, the end at two times. For each day, it tells you what to say and what to send. Keep it with your member list, and you will never miss a day.
Delta_One_Member_Journey_Calendar.title: Member Journey Calendar

Delta_One_Prospect_Conversation_Guide.text: This is how a good conversation goes. Nine moves, from hello to the Key Facts. Seventeen questions that let the other person talk. Ten common objections, with honest answers. And ten simple comparisons that stay inside the rules. Read it before your first ten conversations. Prepare with it; do not recite it.
Delta_One_Prospect_Conversation_Guide.title: Prospect Conversation Guide

Delta_One_Follow_Up_Messages.text: These are ten messages you can send just as they are. From first contact to day eleven. Every message has been checked against the Language Card, so the words are safe. Copy, paste, send. And always send the Key Facts with the first real conversation.
Delta_One_Follow_Up_Messages.title: Follow-up Messages

Delta_One_New_Member_Welcome_Pack.text: This is what you send a new member, and when. Day zero, day one, day eleven, day two hundred. For each day, the document to send and the words to send it with. One rule to remember: the member decides the switch on day eleven, not you. Use this pack the moment a module is confirmed.
Delta_One_New_Member_Welcome_Pack.title: New Member Welcome Pack

Delta_One_Reading_Your_Statement.text: This explains the daily statement, line by line. Every day at twelve noon UTC, a statement arrives. It shows the day's result, and where it went: to a rebuy module, or to the wallet. It shows commissions, level by level, and the differential. And it tells you what to check each day. Open it the first time you see a statement, and you will be able to explain every number.
Delta_One_Reading_Your_Statement.title: Reading Your Daily Statement

Delta_One_Leaders_One_Pager.text: This is one page for leaders, with three habits. Habit one: open new lines, because new lines pay more. Habit two: stay ahead of your people, because the gap is yours. Habit three: keep your leaders active, because only active modules count. Read it once a month, and grade yourself on all three.
Delta_One_Leaders_One_Pager.title: The Leader's One-Pager

Delta_One_About_Delta_One.text: This is who Delta One is. The engine, the founders, and how money is kept safe. The engine trades, and the result is shared: fifty to members, twenty-five to the plan, twenty-five to the company. More than one key is needed to move funds. Settlement is every day at twelve noon UTC. When someone asks, who are these people, open this page with the Key Facts.
Delta_One_About_Delta_One.title: About Delta One

Delta_One_Distributor_Policies_and_Proce.text: These are the rules every distributor agrees to. It is a draft until the lawyers approve it. What you may never claim. How you treat members and their money. What happens with complaints, inactivity, and leaving. Read it before you sign. And open it whenever you are not sure if something is allowed.
Delta_One_Distributor_Policies_and_Proce.title: Distributor Policies & Procedures

Delta_One_Distributor_Agreement.text: This is the agreement between you and Delta One. It is a draft; the company name and the law that applies are still to be filled in. You are independent, not an employee. Commission is paid under the plan as published. And it says how the agreement ends. Read it before you sign. Ask if anything is unclear.
Delta_One_Distributor_Agreement.title: Distributor Agreement

Delta_One_Privacy_and_KYC_Note.text: This note explains the identity check. What is collected, why it is needed, who can see it, and how long it is kept. When a member asks why they must send an identity document, this is the page. It is a draft for legal review.
Delta_One_Privacy_and_KYC_Note.title: Privacy & KYC Note
